selection: Explicit operator-selected architecture/driver identity; no GL_RENDERER substring feature gating.
mapping_note: Aliases below are normalized requirements, NOT claimed vendor counter spellings. Fill raw name/unit/source from the installed target profiler; unavailable counters stay null.

claims.precondition: Previous attachment contents are dead and pass boundaries are identified.
claims.counterexample: Preserved attachment sampled later makes invalidation incorrect.
claims.fallback: Preserve data or clear only after final consumer.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: On-chip render storage exists for the actual driver/configuration.
claims.counterexample: Large MRT/MSAA working set spills and removes the proposed advantage.
claims.fallback: Reduce formats/attachments or retain measured baseline.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: Device exposes useful early-depth/hierarchical-Z behavior for this state.
claims.counterexample: Alpha discard, depth writes or ordering can invalidate assumptions.
claims.fallback: Use correctness-preserving draw ordering and measured alternative.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: Opaque visibility elimination applies to the selected hardware/pass.
claims.counterexample: Blended transparent geometry still shades and blends.
claims.fallback: Separate opaque and transparent costs; do not promise zero overdraw.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: Actual attachment formats/sample counts and dimensions are known.
claims.counterexample: More attachments or MSAA increases footprint past implementation threshold.
claims.fallback: Split/compact only after visual and timing checks.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: Expensive occluded fragment shading exceeds extra vertex/depth work.
claims.counterexample: Cheap shading or geometry-heavy scenes regress with an extra pass.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: Supported sample counts/formats and resolve path are probed.
claims.counterexample: Unsupported formats/custom filtering/extra passes remove on-tile benefit.
claims.fallback: Core supported resolve or lower samples.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: Exact framebuffer-fetch/PLS extension, limits and synchronization are supported.
claims.counterexample: Tile storage pressure or unsupported blend/order semantics reverses gain.
claims.fallback: Portable ping-pong/MRT path with explicit synchronization.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: Texture traffic is measured as implicated cost.
claims.counterexample: ALU-bound or cache-resident workload gains nothing from compression.
claims.fallback: Keep quality-preserving uncompressed or supported compressed format.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: Visible coverage and blending semantics are fixed for A/B.
claims.counterexample: Order changes or background merging can alter alpha composition.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.

claims.precondition: Compatible passes can share targets without extending resource hazards.
claims.counterexample: Fusion expands tile working set or forces extra synchronization.
claims.fallback: Keep separate passes if measured/visual result regresses.
claims.applicability: Probe actual extension/state and target microarchitecture; not all family members implement the named mechanism.
